description: Look up and search HTTP status codes. Operations: "lookup" — Look up a single status code by number.; "search" — Search status codes by number, name or description.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: lookup: The numeric status code, e.g. "404". search: A search query, e.g. "redirect" or "40".

operation.description: lookup — Look up a single status code by number. search — Search status codes by number, name or description.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

name: http-status
title: HTTP Status Code Lookup
